limitations: Point-level OD generated separately after allocation
OSM parts floor bands merged where parent containment>=90%
Node POIs and official industrial sites joined by containment; unmatched sites not forced into nearest buildings
Coastline mask is generalized packaged zoom12 water; not a surveyed shoreline
Unknown buildings use density-derived low-rise priors; morphology is inferred, not observed
Road widths are sensitivity proxies, not surveyed carriageway bounds
Catchments same-function and same-village; straight aggregation segment cannot cross major-road line or water
Unclassified neighborhood-work component adaptive by region; not observed informal/homeworking share
employment_calibration: bounded floor component + explicit residual prior; see employment_capacity_regularization.json
